answer: Copying an answer thus yields nothing, and producing 20 genuinely distinct answers per epoch is real inference work with real latency; the onyx ledger keeps the similarity graph, and the river review can re-run it. A near-duplicate is rejected at the signal gate and the submitting identity is flagged, so one good text cannot be reused across aliases. Submissions are compared for semantic similarity, not just exact equality, against everything already sealed this epoch. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
